crossRefs.keyword: let them slip. Gr. run out, as leaking vessels

translations.web: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
translations.bsb: We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
translations.kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
translations.asv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things that were heard, lest haply we drift away from them.
